Variants.Content: Hrefnesholt fields, herds, timber and iron connect to coastal exchange. Inland grain and repair materials support sailing; blocked landings also trap inland goods.

Hrefnesholt trades grain, herds, timber and iron along the coast. Traveling followers need real food from this production; valuables still require a buyer and exchange. Closed landings also trap inland goods.

Closed landings also trap inland goods. Collectors and distributors depend on the next yield too; extra demands leave losses with continuing suppliers. Hrefnesholt trades grain, herds, timber and iron along the coast.
Hrefnesholt trades grain, herds, timber and iron along the coast. Households need meals and the means to keep producing after delivering goods. Closed landings also trap inland goods.
